# Sanwariya Tech

> AI-powered WhatsApp receptionist for medical clinics. Automates patient appointment booking, token queue management, reminders, and Google review collection — all via WhatsApp.

## About

Sanwariya Tech provides clinics with an AI receptionist that works 24/7 on WhatsApp. Patients can book appointments, get tokens, check clinic hours and fees, and cancel bookings — all without calling the clinic.
